# technitium_api_token (Resource)

Creates a non-expiring API token for a user. The token has the user's permissions and is stored in Terraform state, so protect the state. Tokens cannot be imported because the server only returns the secret once.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The token is stored in state; protect the state.
resource "technitium_api_token" "external_dns" {
  user = technitium_user.external_dns.username
  name = "external-dns"
}

output "external_dns_token" {
  value     = technitium_api_token.external_dns.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Token name shown in the session list.
- `user` (String) Username the token acts as.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Partial token (session identifier).
- `partial_token` (String) Non-secret token prefix used to identify the session.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The API token.
